main_measure.name: mean of -forecast/10 x (coin 5-bar return minus coin mean 5-bar return), active grid bars
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check), t <= -2 rejects, otherwise inconclusive; < 100 active grid cases not observable

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return of the 20% most negative-forecast active grid bars below 0

decided_by: The main measure's t is strictly between -2 and 2.
reading: The coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean over all its non-overlapping grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... with a full 5-bar return inside the window) in all windows, the top 20% is the ceiling of 0.2 x the active grid cases ranked by most negative forecast, and the plan's 'fewer than 100 active grid cases' is applied as the minimum count giving 'not observable'.
